GuideDialogFragment.builder(this)
 .addStep(anchorA, content, GuidePlacement(side = Side.BOTTOM))
 .addStep(anchorB, content, GuidePlacement(side = Side.TOP))

 .listener(guideListener)
 .show(supportFragmentManager)

GuidePlacement(
 side = Side.TOP, // TOP/BOTTOM/START/END/AUTO
 align = Alignment.CENTER,
 offsetX = 0.dp,
 offsetY = 0.dp
)

GuideHighlight(
 maskColor = 0xCC1565C0.toInt(),
 holeOverlayColor = 0x33FFFFFF.toInt(),
 shape = HoleShape.RoundRect(12.dp)
)

GuideTooltip(
 content = GuideContent.Default(
 title = "自定义气泡",
 message = "...",
 titleColor = 0xFF4E342E.toInt(),
 messageColor = 0xFF6D4C41.toInt()
 ),
 backgroundColor = 0xFFFFF8E1.toInt(),
 cornerRadius = 22.dp,
 strokeColor = 0xFFFFB300.toInt(),
 strokeWidth = 2.dp
)

GuideHighlight(
 shape = HoleShape.Circle(), // Rect / RoundRect / Oval / Custom
 padding = 12.dp
)

GuideHighlight(
 shape = HoleShape.RoundRect(14.dp),
 holeAnimation = HoleAnimation.Scale(
 duration = 420L,
 startScale = 0.2f,
 fadeScrim = true
 )
)

GuideStep(
 anchor = GuideAnchor.ViewAnchor(counterButton),
 highlight = GuideHighlight(shape = HoleShape.RoundRect(12.dp)),
 passThroughTargetTouch = true // 洞内点击作用于底部控件
)

GuidePlacement(
 customPosition = { _, size, available ->
 val left = available.centerX() - size.width / 2
 val top = available.bottom - size.height - marginPx
 Rect(left, top, left + size.width, top + size.height)
 }
)

GuideStep(
 anchor = GuideAnchor.RectAnchor { fixedScreenRect },
 followAnchor = false
)
